changes.result: The curated Analyst stakeholder_feedback read permission now exposes only id, location and farm scope, type/group/date, sentiment, themes, public summary, and evidence maturity. Existing row filters are unchanged. The permission inventory was regenerated. This is source-level policy evidence, not effective runtime permission acceptance.
generate_farm_summary rejects missing, aggregate, malformed, and multi-location IDs before cursor creation. SQL projections and report semantics are unchanged.

The private queue now publishes an exact OpenAPI response model for its migration-backed projection, binds rows to the requested location, checks review state and eligibility consistency, rejects undeclared fields, and preserves no-store and tenant-denial behavior.
generate_regenerative_outcomes rejects missing, aggregate, malformed, and multi-location IDs before cursor creation. Its SQL projections and report semantics are unchanged.

The private queue now publishes a strict request-location-bound response contract for the fixed Field Collector 1.2.0 projection. It excludes payload and free text, rejects undeclared fields, and preserves authorization and no-store behavior.

No further field-only narrowing was justified. Auditor feedback access intentionally covers private/all-status rows for forensic review, and the repository has no owner-approved field contract; other operational projections also lack an evidenced narrower field policy. The Auditor rule and other permissions remain unchanged.
